summary: Iteration 13 — Device Health panel + Samsung/SmartThings docs cleanup. 6/6 backend pytests pass; frontend playwright flow validates topbar badge, panel from both entry points, refresh/close, mobile 390px no overflow, and regression tabs. Docs clean of Samsung/SmartThings; Sony Bravia 8.4 table present with all 4 IPs/MACs. RTSP creds not leaked into health IP field.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1300 lines — nearing threshold for splitting into modules (routes/, auth, health).
_health_targets correctly uses regex to strip RTSP user:pass before exposing IP — good.

DeviceHealthPanel useDeviceHealth polls every 30s only when active=true; TopBar invokes with active=true permanently so poll runs continuously once mounted — acceptable but could be opt-out on battery.
test_credentials: PIN 1234 / demo bypass available (DEMO mode preserved at end)
seed_data_creation: None. cam_back.rtsp_url set then restored to empty by test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All devices left in DEMO (live=false). Health endpoint /api/health/devices requires Bearer; returns 7 devices by default (4 Sony TVs, ecobee ping, matrix, amp). RTSP cameras appear only when cameras.<id>.rtsp_url set. Panel opens from open-health-btn (topbar) and settings-health-card (settings drawer, which also closes the drawer via App.js state).
